[SWS_CM_00214] Skeleton E2E Error Handler - Invocation Arguments
Status:
DRAFT
⌈
In case the underlying
DataReader
entity for method requests reports an E2E error,
E2EErrorHandler
shall be called with the following arguments:
•
errorCode
set to the
ProfileCheckStatus
derived from the
DataReader
entity status, similar to [SWS_CM_00210]
•
dataId
set the method’s unique ID
<svcId>Method_<methodName>_Hash
,
as defined by section 7.5.1.1.6 of [22]
•
messageCounter
shall be set to the publication sequence number if available,
zero otherwise
